touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: South Somercotes qualifies as a local detour through CHURCH OF ST PETER and Cross in St Peter's churchyard. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: South Somercotes: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: South Somercotes offers CHURCH OF ST PETER, Cross in St Peter's churchyard, CROSS within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST PETER
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with CHURCH OF ST PETER and Cross in St Peter's churchyard, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
